name: brightdesk-suite
description: Brightdesk — an independent local-first desktop productivity suite with ten integrated apps and protected multilingual spelling resources.

scripts.dist: npm run native:build && npm run verify:licenses && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run native:build && npm run verify:licenses && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run native:build && npm run verify:licenses && electron-builder --mac dmg pkg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run native:build && npm run verify:licenses && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.release: npm run native:build && npm run verify:licenses && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:apps:win: npm run native:build && node scripts/build-apps.js win
scripts.dist:apps:mac: npm run native:build && node scripts/build-apps.js mac
scripts.dist:apps:linux: npm run native:build && node scripts/build-apps.js linux
